name: One Last Night
source:
One Last Night is an 18+ furry visual novel where after your whole world is turned upside down by an unforeseen event, you must navigate all the trials and tribulations that come with it all for the sake of your true love, Marshall.

[From [url=https://mashedp.itch.io/one-last-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《最后一夜》是一款18+兽人视觉小说。突如其来的事件彻底颠覆了你的世界；为了真爱马歇尔，你必须应对随之而来的种种考验与磨难。

[来源：[url=https://mashedp.itch.io/one-last-night]Itch.io[/url]]
